description: Compile a reference remake into a new workflow plan without paying or starting a run. Free. Pass the reference_profile of the ad to remake, the accepted script (copied unchanged), actor_id, a voice and optional ready ast_* assets. The server lays the script on the reference beats and picks templates, captions and sounds; its warnings name everything the plan does not reproduce. Nothing is generated: make missing media separately with generate_image or generate_video, each with its own quote, and compile again. Then approve, quote and run the plan as any other.

assets.description: Your ready ast_* media, used in order by graphics that need it: a compare takes two images. Nothing is generated.

call.description: Your call for a reference beat where the presenter listens to a recorded call: the presenter listens, then freezes, while it plays.

lines.description: The call's turns in order, from both speakers;

phone.description: The in-call phone drawn over the call when no phone_call template covers it;

reference_profile.description: The reference_profile field of a succeeded get_reference_analysis answer, passed unchanged.

script.description: The accepted narration, copied into the plan unchanged.

site.description: Your site, for an end card on the closing beat.

name: plan_reference_remake
title: Compile a reference remake plan
